transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because... since I stopped working, I just can't seem to slow down. I'm always up, moving from one little job to the next all day. Just... feels like I still have a crew waiting on me, I suppose.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?
No... I wouldn't say that. I'm not much of a talker, really. Mostly just... keep to myself, I guess.
Do you find it hard to focus on one thing for a long time?
I don't know... I suppose I can focus fine if I need to. Just... haven't really had to sit still for one thing in a long time.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Not really. I mean... I pretty much just do what needs doing around the house. Nothing too crazy.
Do you feel restless if you're not constantly doing something?

I suppose... maybe a little. Like if I'm sitting through a church service, or... some quiet meeting. I just sort of find myself needing to shift around. Tap my foot, maybe. Sometimes I just want to get up and stretch, even though I know I'm supposed to stay put. But... that's about it.
Do you find yourself easily distracted by things around you?

I suppose. Um... maybe a little. Like, if I'm trying to paint, or... sit down and plan out a story or something. If I hear a truck go by outside, or... I just suddenly think about something out in the garden... my mind just kind of jumps right over there. And then I sort of lose where I was. But... I don't know, I figure that happens to most folks.
Do you feel anxious or uneasy when you're not doing something?
Anxious? No... I don't think so. I mean, if I'm not doing anything, I'm just... not doing anything. It doesn't really bother me.
Do you often fidget with your hands or feet when you're sitting still?
Not really. I mean... aside from what I said earlier about tapping my foot sometimes. But... no, I wouldn't say I do that.
Do you often find yourself taking on more tasks or activities than you can handle?
No, I don't think so. I'm retired, so... there's not really a whole lot of tasks to take on, anyway. Just the house and the garden.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?

I suppose... sometimes. Like, I go to these storytelling meetings, and... well, I might jump in before someone's done talking. I just kind of blurt it out, and then I realize I cut them off. I always feel bad after I do it.
Do you often dominate conversations or have trouble letting others talk?
No, not really. I... I tend to just listen, mostly. Unless I slip up like I mentioned. But I don't try to take over.
Are your symptoms causing problems for you in your daily life or relationships?

I suppose... a little bit. My wife, she... well, she's had to take over keeping the calendar for us. She ends up checking behind me a lot. And... I guess I've had to apologize to the community center, and my garden group, more than once. Just... for letting people down, I suppose.
Do you have mood swings?
No... not that I've noticed. Just... regular moods, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
Do you often intrude on others or insert yourself into their activities?
No, I don't think so. I usually just keep to myself, really. I don't... I don't try to get involved in what other people are doing unless they ask me to.
Do you often feel the need to get up and do something when you're in a quiet environment, like watching TV or reading a book?

I suppose so. I don't really... do well with quiet hobbies for very long anymore. Even if I'm just trying to read, or maybe doing a little sketching... I'll start humming, or talking to myself. Or I just... get up to go mess with something else. So, yes, I guess I do.
Do you often engage in excessive physical activity, such as pacing or doing chores, to the point where it interferes with your daily routine?
No, I don't think I do that. I mean, I'll putter around the house, but... it doesn't get in the way of anything. Just normal stuff.
Do you have trouble controlling your emotions when you're frustrated or upset?
No... not really. I mean, I get frustrated sometimes like anyone else, but I don't... I don't lose control. I just keep it to myself, mostly.
Do you often start tasks without thinking them through?
No, I don't think so. I usually... figure out what I need to do before I start. I don't really jump into things blind.
Do you feel like you're always on the go, even when you're not necessarily doing anything important?

I suppose... yeah. That's sort of why I came in. Ever since I stopped working, I just... I can't seem to slow down. I'm always up, moving from one little job to the next all day. Just feels like... like I still have a crew waiting on me, I guess.
Have you ever had difficulty waiting for your turn in lines or when doing group activities?

I guess so... yeah. Waiting around is tough for me. Like if I'm at the hardware store or... or sitting in the waiting room here. I just get kind of antsy. I catch myself checking my watch a lot, shifting in my seat... just wanting people to hurry up, I suppose.
